notes.title: Major Update 1.1 - New Threats Lurk In The Deep
notes.notes: [p][i]The Last Dig[/i] just got its first major update! Just to knock you out of your comfort zone, it's time to meet new threats in the abyss.[/p][p][/p][h2]🚨 SPOILER WARNING[/h2][p]If you don't want to know what else is waiting for you in the deep, now is the time to dive in blind.[/p][p]The deep won’t wait long.[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠️ New Threats Below[/h2][p]You'll now be hunted by rival miners who are just as hungry for minerals as you are. These guys are excited for a chance to pick your drill apart for scrap.[/p][p]If you hear them, it's time to stop drilling. Enemy miners will feel the vibrations from your drill and go on the hunt.[/p][h2][/h2][h2]💥 New Attack[/h2][p]To help deal with the new threat, you now have a "dive attack" ability. But make sure you stay stocked up on dynamite, you don't want to have deal with these guys up close.[/p][h3][/h3][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]Check out the most notable changes below:[/p][list][*][p]New: Added enemy raider miners[/p][/*][*][p]New: Added "dive" ability. Press down to point your nose into the abyss and dive attack your enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Tutorial merchant now spawns correctly in cases where player dies just before tutorial starts[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: No longer teleporting on some collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Added checks to fix stuck camera zoom[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Animation no longer snaps downward while digging sideways[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]👍 Make Sure to Leave a Review[/h2][p]Enjoying the game? Make sure to leave a review so the Steam algorithm knows this game is a hidden gem.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for this update. See you in the abyss,[/p][p]- Mr. Chuckle[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New: Dead miners now appear with bonus resources
[*] Change: Made music changes more gradual
[*] Change: Changed heat upgrade description to be more clear
[*] Change: Merchants now carry much more stock near the end of the game
[*] Fix: "Full cargo" warning after selling or spending cargo on upgrades
[*] Fix: Boss animations are now timed correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Release 1.0
notes.notes: [h1]🎉 Demo Release – [i]The Last Dig[/i] is Now Playable![/h1][p]The demo for [i]The Last Dig[/i] is officially live—and I couldn’t be more excited to share it with you![/p][p]I could never quite find the game I wanted: a game about mining into a dark, deep, ancient abyss where [i]anything[/i] might be waiting. So I spent the last year building it myself. Now, it's ready for you to play.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]❤️ Like What You See?[/h2][p]If you're enjoying the demo, please [b]wishlist[/b] [i]The Last Dig[/i] and [b]share[/b] it with friends. Visibility is everything for small indie games and your support makes a huge difference.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🗣️ Your Feedback Shapes the Game[/h2][p]This demo is just the beginning. Your feedback is essential to help shape what's next—whether it’s bugs, balance, or bold new ideas.[/p][p]💬 Share your thoughts in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3205800/discussions/"]Steam Discussions[/url].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ What’s Coming Next[/h2][p]I'm squashing bugs as fast as I can so I can get back to building new content. Here's a glimpse at what’s on the horizon:[/p][list][*][p][b]More lethal threats[/b]: Beware new enemies lurking in the abyss[/p][/*][*][p][b]Full controller support[/b]: Navigate menus and customize your rig comfortably[/p][/*][*][p][b]More mysteries to uncover[/b]: What was that sound? Something’s down there…[/p][/*][/list]
